Demo review: C3 timing capacitor and source-bound analysis
The mixed ECO replaces C1 with the 1 uF radial film C3 and adds TP1 on OUT. Keep the timing-node wiring explicit and verify C3 pin membership against the native netlist. The saved PI and QuickTherm files belong to this blinker PCB revision; do not interpret them as results for the new hello world encoder. This is a drawing-level demo annotation created in Pocket KiView.
